div.head: I Cn 17.2
div.ab: And beo þam halgum tidum, ealswa hit riht is, eallum Cristenum mannum sib ⁊ som gemǽne ⁊ ælc sacu totwæmed.
⁊ beo ðam halgum tidum eallum Cristenum mannum, ealswa hit riht is, sib ⁊ sóm gemǽne ⁊ ælc sacu totwæmed.
And beo þam halgan tidum, ealswa hit riht is, eallum Cristenum mannum śyb ⁊ sóm geméne ⁊ ælc sacu totwæmed.
Et sit in his sanctis obseruationibus, sicut uere iustum est, Christianis omnibus pax et concordia, et omnis ira tollatur.
[17, 2] In his diebus sit pax et securitas omnibus Christianis, et lis et contentio destruatur.
Sitque in sanctis temporibus omnibus Christianis, ueluti iustissimum est, pax et concordia communis omnisque inimicitia segregata.
⁊ beo ðam halgum tidum eallum Cristenum mannum, ealswa hit riht is, sib ⁊ sóm gemǽne ⁊ ælc sacu totwæmed.
And beo þam halgum tidum, ealswa hit riht is, eallum Cristenum mannum sib and som gemæne, and ælc sacu totwæmed.
Und an den heiligen Festen sei, wie es recht ist, allen christlichen Menschen Friede und Eintracht gemeinsam und jeder Rechtsstreit (Trug Ld) eingestellt.
And at the holy seasons, as is right, let there be peace and concord among all Christian people, and every lawsuit (fraud, Ld) suspended.
And at the holy festivals, as is fitting, there shall be peace and concord among all Christian men, and every dispute shall be laid aside.
And at holy times, just as is proper, there is to be peace and friendship among all Christians, and each dispute is to be resolved.
